daily_narrative.happened: Stocks rallied broadly, led by a 2.7% jump in the NASDAQ and 3.5% gain in technology while VIX fell 7.9%; the move appears to reflect a risk-on shift rather than a single catalyst, with losers concentrated in Energy and a few idiosyncratic names like ADBE and HIMS. In context, the transition regime and 1M factor leadership in Value and Momentum over Growth, plus Russell 2000 strength, point to a broadening advance with investors favoring cyclicals and smaller-cap exposure alongside megacap tech.
